summary: Bind inactive human attention and canonical STOP arrangements to main storage

replay.detail: No production source is registered and no scan, replay or backfill is added. Existing native attention reads remain in use.

schema.detail: Table and index definitions are unchanged. Explicit inactive helper setup now selects main rather than a TEMP shadow. Selected human runs and STOP maxima require their existing named main index; physical schema and index eligibility remains source-owned.

rules.detail: No admission, projection, checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No public protocol, native attention predicate or actor visibility changes. The helpers refuse a missing read index instead of allowing a scan fallback.

downtime.detail: No production registration, startup work or service interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: No action is required for existing installations. Complete native capture, lifecycle and source coverage remain prerequisites for future activation.

recovery.detail: Native production readers are unchanged. A missing inactive arrangement index returns an error without rebuilding from a read. Main qualification does not certify replaced schemas, triggers or lifetime continuity.
